object.attr: stakeholder: acks move to the full hash, and SHA-256 repositories use 64 digits (Decided on 2026-11-10, with TRACE; review Q11). A release that reads both forms has to come before one that writes the full hash. What an ack matching no commit or several means is MELLON-TRACE-SRS's.
object.description: Mellon shall read an ack attribute of 7 to 64 hex digits, in either letter case, as the commit whose hash begins with the ack's digits.
